task_description:
# AFL Formation Templates

Pre-built starting formation templates for common AFL setups (e.g., standard setup, zone defense, press, spread). One click positions all players in a recognized formation.

## Rationale
Saves time on initial setup and provides starting points for tactical variations. This is an AFL-specific feature that multi-sport tools can't offer, strengthening differentiation.

## User Stories
- As a coach, I want to quickly set up standard formations without dragging 36 players
- As a coaching educator, I want to demonstrate common AFL formations easily

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] At least 5 pre-built formation templates
- [ ] Template selector in toolbar or sidebar
- [ ] Applying template positions all 36 players
- [ ] Can modify formation after applying template
- [ ] Templates include both team formations
- [ ] Users can save custom templates
